entry_state: Transition methods retain the evidence and information allowed for each group. Reconstructed expectations are not hindsight, prescribed nil treatments do not erase known cash, and group fair value is distinct from FCF and investment holdings. Opening equity follows group-by-group margin and loss calculations; the recoverable part of a transition loss follows next.
exit_state: Chapter 12 closes with distinct issued and held transition balances, scoped timing exceptions and dated reported evidence. Insurance quantities require their own group, method, information and source history; numerical illustrations and documentary exchanges leave actual calibration and implementation acceptance pending. The next chapter turns to implementation contracts.
findings: The transition recovery exception relaxes one treaty-timing condition without supplying its full measurement or other admission facts.
Reported transition percentages and capital-charge parameters retain their dated denominators and entity scope.
The chapter ending preserves future domain and implementation acceptance rather than claiming readiness. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
